requiredDesignDetails.title: Concrete native UI-observed marker acquisition
requiredDesignDetails.requirement: Specify actual XCTest→host transport and bind live alert observation to nonce before acknowledgment. No app isPresented flag, elapsed delay or app-authored gate readiness is UI visibility proof. Native marker must include same run/PID/session/capture/confirmation generation/metadata selection, actual exact alert title/body+Recover/Not now existence/positive whole frames and screenshot attachment identity/timestamp; retain actual raw marker before validation.
requiredDesignDetails.candidateAssessment: Unbuffered FileHandle.standardOutput.write from XCTest after actual screenshot/geometry is coherent and needs no assumed runner appgroup entitlement. Use unique bounded one-line JSON marker with strict partial/chunked line parsing; zero/duplicate/malformed/mismatched/stale records cannot acknowledge. Local isolated pipe/parser controls do not establish live XCTest→xcodebuild forwarding. Actual native run must establish forwarding; missing/delayed stdout fails boundedly with no write and preserved failure.
requiredDesignDetails.directRunnerFileAlternative: Only use test-runner-owned or appgroup direct path after actual permission/path/identity reachability is proven. No assumed shared appgroup capability.

requiredDesignDetails.title: No late mutation after alert lifecycle changes
requiredDesignDetails.requirement: Explicitly invalidate nonce/generation and cancel waiter on Not now/isPresented false, actual Recover tap, disappearance/Back, session/appearance change, timeout/cancellation/error/new attempt. Check same current session/appearance/generation/frozen metadata selection and actual cancellation/expiry immediately before serialized write, with no suspension between final authorization and single mutation. Fresh owner may never rearm old gate; duplicate scheduling/replayed ack cannot write.
requiredDesignDetails.boundary: State the exact linearization: dismissal/cancel processed before final write authorization prevents mutation. Do not claim unobservable OS gesture delivery/continuous visual presentation or arbitrary external races. Do not recapture raw authority into ConfirmationSelection/UI state. Record whether Task vs explicit control canceled instead of inventing either.

requiredDesignDetails.title: Native system-alert metadata remains an observation prerequisite
requiredDesignDetails.requirement: SwiftUI alert Recover accessibilityValue propagation and live updates are not established by this draft/current source. Preserve visible label and actual real Recover action; do not silently substitute custom alert or test action to manufacture visibility. Native must query actual nonce/value and fail safely if absent/retargeted. A separately nonce-bound host relay to runner is an alternative only with explicit source/transport design.
requiredDesignDetails.ordering: XCTest captures and publishes observed-alert marker first; host validates unchanged old data/source/provider/owner and exact gate then ack; native logs write-before/write-after while same presentation valid; host validates targetchanged; XCTest taps actual Recover only after both native mutated and host-targetchanged. Native changed-error is required, not assumed from fixture mutation.

Real cancellation/dismissal/timeout before ack and between wake and final authorization: no late write, with explicit no-suspension/linearization boundary. Duplicate arm or task completion must not write twice.

Native actual alert action identifier/value/whole title/body/actions positive finite geometry+original screenshot; no elapsed-only visibility. Isolated stdout controls are not real XCTest forwarding proof.
